operations.restore: Restore all nine isolated snapshots into a private staging directory; never serve staging files.
operations.read: Recheck current identity, organization, assignment, revision, tombstones and retention before bytes.
operations.replay: Look up the original operation; unknown remains held and never creates another effect.

retention_exception.source: current read facts only; never backup metadata or a caller override
retention_exception.rules: Only reviewed identity/possession proof permits this exception; unsubmitted uploads and audit references do not. Both assertions must be active, match every required binding and the same case and positive integer revisions; the case must need this file. Missing, revoked or cross-scope assertions deny; mismatched revisions are stale.
